newsitem.title: USA: UPR expects strong Pennzoil response Monday.
newsitem.headline: UPR expects strong Pennzoil response Monday.

text.p: Union Pacific Resources Group Inc is confident it will receive a strong level of acceptances by the first closing of its tender offer for Pennzoil Co shares on Monday, company chairman George Lidahl said in a telephone interview after second quarter earnings.
"We expect the tender results to provide a mandate for our offer," Lindahl said.
Asked whether UPR would consider raising its $84 cash and stock offer for Pennzoil, Lindahl said the offer and its structure were fair.
"There is no talk of raising the price, but as we have always said, we are willing to sit down and negoatiate with the Pennzoil board," he said.
Pennzoil has refused to consider the hostile offer or meet with UPR to discuss it.
